The [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE" /> [[H'nemthe/Legends|H'nemthe]] was '''invaded''' by [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] at some point during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="CCG" /> spanning from [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> Following the invasion<ref name="CCG" /> and subjugation,<ref name="CSWE" /> many members of the planet's [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[H'nemthe (species)/Legends|H'nemthe]], abandoned their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]<ref name="CCG" /> to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] on<ref name="CSWE" /> the planet<ref name="Anoat">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Anoat/Legends|Anoat]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The invasion of H'nemthe was introduced in ''[[Jabba's Palace Limited]]'', an expansion of [[Decipher]]'s ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]'' released in [[1998]].<ref name="CCG" />
